title: The Body's Cleanup Crew
intro: This quiz covers the excretory and urinary systems explained in the story.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of the excretory system?
choices: To help the body grow taller
To remove waste the body does not need
questions.explanation: The excretory system removes waste the body does not need.

choices: Carry urine out of the body
Filter the blood and remove extra water, salts, and waste
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter the blood and remove extra water, salts, and waste.

questions.prompt: Which shows the correct path urine takes through the urinary system?
questions.explanation: Urine travels from the kidneys through the ureters to the bladder, then out through the urethra.

questions.prompt: Which organs remove carbon dioxide when you breathe out?
questions.explanation: The lungs remove carbon dioxide when you breathe out.

questions.prompt: Why is drinking water important for the urinary system?
choices: It helps the kidneys move waste out of the body
It stops the lungs from working
It makes the bladder filter the blood
questions.explanation: Water helps the kidneys move waste out of the body.
